verdict_rule: per cell, row, level, and comparator: D = SHD(Andrey) - SHD(reference) per dataset, each the mean over 5 draws; side = where the 95% percentile bootstrap interval of mean D lies, read on the ends as computed, as the gate read them; worse = above 0 on seeds 0-19 and on a rerun on fresh seeds 100-119; better = below 0 on seeds 0-19 and on a rerun on fresh seeds (100-119, or 6000-6019 for J2 at the default level); a row is judged only where the library beats the empty graph. In a row, multi_draw holds the interval on seeds 0-19, side its side, replication the rerun on seeds 100-119, confirmation the rerun on seeds 6000-6019 (at the defaults), and verdict the result; out of claim, verdict is the side
residue_note: interval ends that are floating-point residue of an exact 0, read as computed (the gate's reading); a positive lower end sends a row to a rerun; an entry is on seeds 0-19 unless it names a rerun's seeds. Read exactly, as 0, four verdicts change: the W row's interval on seeds 0-19 contains 0, so it ties and is not rerun; the two Y8 inhibiting n 1,000 rows at alpha 1e-2 against the patched copy tie instead of lower, no rerun; and Y8 inhibiting n 10,000 at the defaults against the library contains 0 on seeds 6000-6019, so it is lower on seeds 0-19 only instead of better (10 better, not 11), and the confirmation counts 17 rows below 0 for each candidate, a tie that its rule, written before any fit, gives to alpha one over the observational rows. Here interval ends are rounded to 4 decimals except those residue ends, which stay as computed
fit_protocol: every package of a dataset in its own child process pinned to one core with one BLAS thread; 5 draws per dataset in claim (Andrey seed 0-4, the library's Python random and NumPy global generator seeded 0-4), one out of claim; a cap of 1,800 s per draw in claim and 3,600 s out of it, a draw over it a timeout, never scored
error_metric: SHD of the interventional essential graph, as the median over the paired datasets of each dataset's mean over its draws (the _mean fields hold the means)
complete_definition: true when every setting has at least 10 paired datasets (both packages finished); a setting with fewer is listed in incomplete, its timeouts counted in the timeout columns and never scored
seeds_note: seeds is the number of datasets attempted per setting: 20 (seeds 0-19), 10 (seeds 0-9) at 50 and 100 variables; 5 draws per dataset in claim, 1 out of claim; reruns on seeds 100-119 in the {len(rerun_cells)} in-claim cells with a comparison above 0 on seeds 0-19, and, at the defaults, the confirmation's seeds 6000-6019 in every in-claim cell. Categorical data (Andrey alone) and 200 and 400 variables (no library run) are in the lane file only
incomplete: IGSP at alpha 1e-3, 5 starts vs graphical-model-learning 0.1a8, igsp_o1_perfect_k10
